description_html:
A superb example of a Type 20, refurbished throughout by Thomson Brothers. With a south facing reception room and bespoke Hulsta fitted office furniture in the L-shaped reception room. The kitchen has integrated appliances including a low level fridge and freezer, grill and microwave oven, Siemens induction hob, wine fridge and dishwasher. The inner hall has Hulsta fitted cupboards.A superb example of a Type 20, refurbished throughout by Thomson Brothers. With a south facing reception room and bespoke Hulsta fitted office furniture in the L-shaped reception room. The kitchen has integrated appliances including a low level fridge and freezer, grill and microwave oven, Siemens induction hob, wine fridge and dishwasher. The inner hall has Hulsta fitted cupboards.

It has outstanding transport links to all London airports via the Elizabeth Line which is 75 yards away at Farringdon, and the Barbican tube station (Hammersmith & City, Circle and Metropolitan lines) is less than 50 yards away along with stops for several bus routes. It is close to St Paul's Cathedral in the heart of the City of London.

Extended lease.
